prompts: Asset type: production UV TEXTURE ATLAS for lightweight Blender console replicas, not an illustration of consoles. The attached images are references for authentic hardware colours and sharp pixel-art treatment only. Create ONE exactly aligned 4 columns by 4 rows texture sheet, sixteen equal square cells, edge to edge, no gutters. Crisp deliberately low-resolution 16-bit pixel art, flat orthographic surfaces, no perspective, no bevel lighting, no shadows, no random grain/no speckles/no weathering. Each square is a flat material or decal that will be mapped to actual 3D geometry. Row 1 left-right: (0) completely uniform neutral near-white ABS plastic #EEEEEE; (1) completely uniform cool gray ABS #A6A6AD; (2) completely uniform charcoal black ABS #22232A; (3) brushed dark walnut wood, fine regular horizontal pixel stripes, no perspective. Row 2: (4) classic red arcade side-panel artwork, flat red field with restrained angular orange stripe like reference 3, no text; (5) orange/yellow arcade control panel flat field with black trim, NO joystick or buttons because these are geometry; (6) arcade marquee, yellow-orange field thin white/black rectangular border, exact word ARCADE centered in block pixel letters; (7) black metal coin-door face with two small rectangular red coin slots and tiny keyhole, frontal flat, no perspective. Row 3: (8) classic red Nintendo wordmark and small ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM lettering on flat cool gray, generous blank margins; (9) red SUPER NINTENDO text on cool gray with small gray entertainment system subtitle, blank margins; (10) large authentic gold 16-BIT lettering on solid black; (11) classic multicolour N64 N emblem on solid charcoal. Row 4: (12) classic coloured PlayStation P/S emblem and black PlayStation text on light gray; (13) dark blue Nintendo GAME BOY lettering on warm light gray; (14) white SEGA lettering on solid black; (15) monochrome olive LCD screen, a few crisp stair-step pale-green reflection bands, no game, no character, no UI. Keep each cell fully separate and aligned at exact 25% boundaries, no labels outside the requested decals. No console silhouettes, no assembled models, no watermark or signature. Desired native 512x512 atlas with pixels visibly grouped into simple clusters.

Create ONE production pixel-art decal UV atlas, strict 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen exactly equal square cells, edge to edge no gaps. Flat orthographic label artwork, NOT assembled hardware or a scene. Authentic retro console typography, crisp 16-bit block pixels, no shadows, no 3D lighting, no grain or weathering, no watermark. Each wordmark centered with large blank margins; all marks readable. Row 1: SEGA GAME GEAR wordmark with little red green blue squares on charcoal black; gold LYNX wordmark on flat dark olive green; NEO GEO POCKET wordmark on cool gray; NEO GEO POCKET COLOR wordmark on cobalt blue. Row 2: WonderSwan wordmark on ivory gray; WonderSwan Color wordmark on navy blue; PSP white wordmark on pure black; GAME BOY ADVANCE white outlined wordmark on flat indigo purple. Row 3: GAME BOY COLOR wordmark with multicolour COLOR letters on black; Nintendo DS wordmark on silver gray; Nintendo 3DS wordmark with red 3 on black; PC Engine red and dark gray wordmark on near-white ivory. Row 4: classic Atari three-prong Fuji emblem with ATARI text in silver on pure black; ATARI 7800 wordmark in dark letters on flat silver; IBM striped dark-blue wordmark on warm beige; plain cartridge grip material of dark charcoal with fine regular straight horizontal black grooves edge to edge, no lettering. The artwork is to be UV mapped onto manually constructed accurate lightweight 3D replicas. Absolutely no perspectives, consoles, rounded objects, drop shadows, out-of-cell labels, signatures, invented extra branding. Desired native 512x512 pixel image, grid boundaries at exact quarters.

Edit target is the attached existing 4-by-4 square technical UV texture atlas. Preserve exact 4x4 uniform square layout, tile positions, full bleed edges, no gaps. Preserve ALL tiles not explicitly named. These are flat tiny pixel-art faceplate decals for faithful low-poly hardware, NOT pictures of consoles. Replace row1 col2 (zero based tile1, currently plain gray) with accurate silver-white SEGA GENESIS North American original model1 wordmark on perfectly solid black, SEGA small above angular GENESIS inside its elongated silver outline, no perspective. Replace row1 col3 (tile2, currently charcoal) with single-line white GAME BOY ADVANCE wordmark, original italic thin lettering, centered on perfectly solid black, no surrounding box or two-line logo. Replace row3 col1 (tile8): authentic NES-001 front print: red Nintendo text WITHOUT an oval enclosure, small red ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM underneath, on uniform light gray. Replace row3 col2 (tile9) SUPER NINTENDO ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM decal in DARK GRAY not red, on uniform light gray, retain authentic condensed italic letters. Replace row3 col3 (tile10) with small accurate WHITE/silver 16-BIT lettering, on perfectly solid black, no gold. Replace row3 col4 (tile11): authentic Nintendo64 logo comprising ONLY the iconic single interlocking extruded four-sided N, green front blue right yellow top with small red side; NOT the text N64 or 64 as the main shape. Under that N add tiny white NINTENDO 64 lettering on solid charcoal. Keep other tiles EXACTLY as existing. Crisp deliberate 16-bit pixel art, limited palette, hard pixel edges, no gradients or grunge, no photoreal texture, no mockups, no new objects.

Edit the target technical 4x4 pixel art UV atlas. Change ONLY row1 column2 (tile1): replace SEGA GENESIS with original MEGA DRIVE branding, authentic angular slanted white MEGA DRIVE wordmark, tiny blue SEGA beneath, on perfectly solid black. Change ONLY row3 column3 (tile10): change white 16-BIT to GOLD 16-BIT as original Mega Drive 1. All other 14 tiles must be identical, especially approved arcade row2 unchanged. Maintain exact4x4 grid no gutters. Flat pixel-art labels, no photos, no console illustration, no new words, no gradients, crisp low resolution.
